overall.description: 2-3 sentence meta-assessment of the findings set as a whole: overall quality, notable provider disagreements, dominant failure modes

assessments.description: Exactly one assessment per input finding id (F1..Fn). Do not invent ids that are not in the input.

id.description: Finding id exactly as given in the input (e.g. F1)

recommendation.description: apply = genuinely good idea, worth applying; skip = not worth applying (weak, wrong, or cost exceeds benefit); discuss = defensible either way, needs a human call

rationale.description: 1-3 sentences: cost/benefit of applying this finding to the target file. Grounded in the finding's own evidence and the target file content only.

refuted.description: true when the finding is factually wrong or does not apply to the target file as written

refuted_reason.description: Required when refuted=true: concrete reason with reference to target file content; null otherwise

cross_check.description: What verifier cross-checking shows, using anonymized labels: e.g. 'A+B agree independently', 'C-only, unconfirmed', 'contradicts F3'; agreement is a weak signal (correlated errors) — record it, do not treat it as proof; null when nothing notable

adjusted_severity.description: Arbiter's calibrated severity; may differ from the providers' severity
